{{Top|leg}}
The '''Duff-Jikab''', also known as the '''Cutthroat Hunt''', revolved around captives attempting to evade [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], or other types of pursuers, in a game-type atmosphere. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], as a captive of [[Quaffug]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], was forced to take part in one.
